β.m: Lower-case beta (βῆτα), the second letter of the ancient Greek alphabet. It represented the voiced bilabial plosive: /b/ and later the voiced labiodental fricative /v/. It is preceded by α and followed by γ

n: The letter beta (βῆτα), the second letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.
